inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped SELECT feeds REPLACE INTO so one keyed aggregate row is refreshed from source data.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one existing channel rollup and one grouped source row while retaining REPLACE INTO, aggregation, and RETURNING of the resulting row.

fixture_notes: The existing web rollup starts with stale values and must be replaced by the one-event aggregate; RETURNING exposes the refreshed row.
determinism_notes: One fixed grouping key and one final ordered row; RETURNING has one row. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE channel_rollups_min (rollup_day DATE NOT NULL, channel_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, total_units INT NOT NULL, event_count INT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rollup_day, channel_code))
CREATE TABLE channel_events_min (event_id INT PRIMARY KEY, event_day DATE NOT NULL, channel_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, units INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: REPLACE INTO channel_rollups_min (rollup_day, channel_code, total_units, event_count) SELECT event_day, channel_code, SUM(units), COUNT(*) FROM channel_events_min GROUP BY event_day, channel_code RETURNING rollup_day, channel_code, total_units, event_count

checks.sql: SELECT rollup_day, channel_code, total_units, event_count FROM channel_rollups_min ORDER BY rollup_day, channel_code
